info.name: DWS – Salesforce Embed API
info.description:
Design Workspace (DWS) backend — the two endpoints Salesforce calls to embed a design on the Opportunity screen. No authentication (POC). Every call is the **embedded** variant: read-only, with internal-only content left out of the response.

## Set this first
Open the collection **Variables** tab and set `baseUrl` to the deployed host, e.g. `http://usdendrh5070:8091`. Everything else uses variables, so nothing else needs editing.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8091` | protocol + host + port of the DWS backend |
| `opportunityId` | `0061t00000TuVwXyZaBc` | which opportunity the parameterized requests hit |
| `artifactId` | `summary` | which file the download request fetches |

## The two endpoints
| Endpoint | Returns |
|---|---|
| `GET …/opportunities/{id}/tabs?embed=true` | every tab of the workspace, as data (client renders it) |
| `GET …/opportunities/{id}/artifacts?embed=true` | list of downloadable files; each has a `downloadUrl` |
| `GET …/opportunities/{id}/artifacts/{artifactId}?embed=true` | the file itself — PNG, PDF or XLSX |

`embed=true` is the default on the server, but we send it explicitly on every request so intent is obvious.

## Sample opportunities (mock data)
Three opportunities exist in the POC fixture. Anything else returns **404**.

| Opportunity Id | Design | Project | Customer | Value | Stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0061t00000AbCdEfGhI` | PRJ-001 | EV Battery Management System | Tesla Motors | $2.4M | Design Phase |
| `0061t00000JkLmNoPqRs` | PRJ-003 | Smart Grid Controller | ABB Ltd | $1.5M | Pre-production |
| `0061t00000TuVwXyZaBc` | PRJ-008 | Railway Signaling System | Hitachi Rail | $4.5M | Validation/Testing |

The **Sample opportunities** folder has ready-to-send Tabs + Artifacts requests for each of the three, with the ids already filled in.

## Downloading a file
Send an **artifact download** request, then use Postman's **Save Response → Save to a file** — the body is the raw PNG/PDF/XLSX bytes.

request.description: All seven tabs for the opportunity in {{opportunityId}}: overview, block-diagrams, part-intel, fast-repo, support, ai-assistant, supplier-collab. Every tab has the same shape — tab-level `fields`, then `items`, each its own set of key/value `fields` with a `tone`.
Downloadable files for the opportunity — metadata only (name, format, size, `downloadUrl`). Copy any `id` from the response into the `artifactId` variable to fetch it with the download request.

The file bytes for `artifactId`. PNGs and PDFs come back inline (a PNG can go straight into an ); spreadsheets download. Use Save Response → Save to a file to keep it. Default `artifactId` is `summary`, which exists for all three opportunities.

request.description: $2.4M · Design Phase. Note an NRND part in Part Intelligence.
Embedded artifacts: summary (pdf), diagram-BD-1180 (png), bill-of-materials (xlsx), document-power-architecture-rev-c-pdf (pdf), document-preliminary-bom-xlsx (pdf).
$1.5M · Pre-production. Design frozen, no open queries.

Embedded artifacts: summary (pdf), diagram-BD-0902 (png), diagram-BD-0915 (png), bill-of-materials (xlsx), document-controller-architecture-rev-d-pdf (pdf), document-qualification-plan-pdf (pdf), document-production-bom-xlsx (pdf).
$4.5M · Validation/Testing. Two open queries, a last-time-buy part, a diagram needing rework.
A real PDF. Send, then Save Response → Save to a file to open it.
Any id that is not one of the three sample opportunities returns 404 with a message naming the id. This is the expected 'no design linked' response, not an error to debug.
